The amended Commerce charter states a duration through October 31, 1998 unless properly terminated or renewed. It retains an October 1 reporting deadline, while Appendix E recognizes December 31. The report therefore contains different update vintages. Footnote 5 on printed page 145 dates the duration amendment June 17, 1997; preserve this printed year without silently correcting it.

Section 3(b) revokes the parent as amended; section 3 describes committees that already terminated and completed their work. Later revocation does not establish first cessation or resolve the earlier charter gap.
